Welcome to Carriage House - a modern, meticulously-maintained elevator building tucked away in a park-like setting on the Norwalk/Darien line. This sun-filled unit offers a bright, open-concept layout with soaring ceilings, hardwood floors throughout, and added privacy with no direct views into neighboring buildings. The spacious kitchen features abundant cabinet space, newer appliances, and a breakfast bar that flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas. The Primary Suite offers two generous closets and a private full bath. A well-sized second bedroom with a large closet is adjacent to a second full bath. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, central A/C, a spacious pantry closet, and TWO reserved garage parking spaces (#7 and #22) with an automatic garage door opener, plus guest parking. Ideally located minutes from Metro North, I-95, shopping, dining, and more. Note: Photos are from the previous listing.
